_comment: One place for every AI tool link. When a PartnerStack affiliate link is issued, paste it into affiliate_url and rebuild; every in-text link, toolbox box and sidebar entry picks it up. While affiliate_url is null the build falls back to the official homepage, with rel="nofollow sponsored noopener" already in place.
disclosure: Some links in this box are affiliate links. If you subscribe through one, Omong Studio may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. These are tools used in the workflow above; nothing here is paid placement.
disclosure_short: Some outbound links are affiliate links (no extra cost to you).

elevenlabs.name: ElevenLabs
elevenlabs.blurb: Text-to-speech with saved voices, so a narrator sounds the same in episode 9 as in episode 1. Export a WAV per line and you get timings you can cut against.

gamma.name: Gamma
gamma.blurb: Turns a shot list or a client brief into a presentable deck without opening a slide app. Useful when the storyboard has to be shown to someone else.

adcreative.name: AdCreative.ai
adcreative.blurb: Batch creative variants when a single hook needs ten thumbnails instead of one. Good for testing, not for the hero frame.

browseai.name: Browse AI
browseai.blurb: Watches a page and returns structured rows without a scraper. Handy for tracking release dates, stock or listing changes while you work.
